name: separator-radix
title: Separator
description: A one-pixel horizontal or vertical rule that separates content, decorative by default and semantic on request.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>
docs:
Installed `separator.tsx` in `components/ui`.

Import: `import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"`

```tsx
<Separator orientation="vertical" />
```

Colors and radius come from your theme's shadcn tokens (--primary, --border, --radius, and so on).
